inspection_scope.method: Read-only GitHub tree and selected source/configuration inspection; no path changes, builds, imports, tests or native calls were performed by this audit.
inspection_scope.coverage: Selected confirmed consumers, not an exhaustive reference inventory. A complete checkout-wide reference and runtime-path inventory remains a migration gate.

authority.rule: The three implementation directories do not identify the theoretical K/t/X domains, confer equal semantic authority, or require each implementation to duplicate the semantic kernel.
authority.preserved_boundary: Rust remains the sole authority for semantic identities, checked IR, histories, cells and certificates. Python adapts or orchestrates checked results. Versioned JSON IR is the language-independent interchange boundary.
authority.operation_meaning: A path is resolved relative to an invocation, package or contract root. Equal bytes at a new filename do not alone establish operational equivalence: interpreter, entrypoint, schema, argument order, scope, capabilities, history and resource accounting must remain related by an explicitly checked migration.

path_mappings.import_boundary: A top-level python/adva.py beside an existing package does not necessarily shadow it in every import context, but introduces avoidable launch/import ambiguity. Package-qualified entrypoints preserve a clear namespace.
